projections.note: Every variable the summary flags fully. A sometimes-sensitive claim (KansligVariabelIbland 1, or a cell that is not 0 or 1) makes the variable sensitive whatever the plain claim says; a plain sensitive claim stays sensitive beside a conditional 0; only a plain 0 with a conditional 0 is built non-sensitive. sxc0 and nosum are absent: their sensitivity is unknown, and it is not defaulted to false.

Every issue of the build. The fully flagged variables raise none (the old ratchet tests' `result.diagnostics == ()`). A conditional 0 beside a blank plain cell supplies no sensitivity, so sxc0 is withheld for is_sensitive alone; nosum has no summary row and is withheld for both flags.
